decisions.decision: IFF parser algorithm: top-level FORM IS the file (no file-bound check on top-level); nested chunks raise NestedChunkOverflow on parent-bound failure; leaf payload streaming-read EOF raises Truncated
decisions.rationale: Iter-3 cross-AI review (codex) caught that the previous algorithm made Truncated unreachable on nested chunks because file-bound check on outer chunk fired first. The new algorithm makes each IffParseError enum value reachable via a distinct deterministic code path.

decisions.decision: Cross-AI adversarial review pattern is the right methodology
decisions.rationale: 4-cycle convergence (22 → 12 → 12 → 0 new HIGH findings) validated the methodology. Iter-3 caught a real Windows API bug (loaderObserved.loadErrors vs PluginLoader.LoadFromDirectory) that single-reviewer review would have shipped. The marginal cost (~5-10 min per review) is worth it for phases with real architectural surface.
